title: JANUS Lossless Origin / Derivation / Authority Machine v1.0
machine_formula: SOURCE_BYTES -> RAW_SEAL -> NAMESPACED_ORIGIN -> IMMUTABLE_ENVELOPE -> {REPRESENTATION_BRANCHES, STRICT_PARSE_PROBE} -> {DERIVED_ARTIFACTS | IMPERFECT_WITNESS_QUARANTINE} -> DECLARED_INTEGRITY_CHECK -> PROVENANCE_GRAPH -> CONTEXT_FIREWALL -> MULTI_AXIS_AUTHORITY -> EXPLICIT_ADMISSION -> AUDIT_EXPORT

components.name: ACQUIRE_OPAQUE_BYTES
components.contract: Acquire source bytes before interpretation. File extension is a hint, never proof of JSON validity.

components.name: SEAL_RAW_WITNESS
components.contract: Compute raw_sha256 and raw_size over exact source bytes before parse, repair, canonicalization, compression, or normalization.

components.name: NAMESPACE_ORIGIN
components.contract: Origin identity binds repository + commit/version + path + raw_sha256. Content-equivalent origins remain distinct observations.

components.name: IMMUTABLE_ORIGIN_ENVELOPE
components.contract: Store or address exact raw bytes, source metadata, and raw hash in a lossless envelope; source bytes are immutable.

components.name: REPRESENTATION_FORK
components.contract: Compression, canonicalization, minification, parse trees, repair, indexing, embeddings and exports are child representations or derivatives, never the raw witness itself.

components.name: COMPRESSION_REPRESENTATION_IDENTITY
components.contract: Record parent_raw_sha256, representation_sha256, codec/version/parameters/packaging-metadata policy and sizes for every compressed representation.

components.name: LOSSLESS_ROUNDTRIP_GATE
components.contract: Admit a lossless compressed representation only when D(C(raw)) is byte-equal to raw and SHA256(D(C(raw))) equals raw_sha256.

components.name: STREAM_ACCESS_LAYER
components.contract: Compressed JSON may be consumed through a codec stream without materializing a complete uncompressed file; a JSON parser receives decoded bytes, not opaque compressed bytes.

components.name: STRICT_PARSE_PROBE
components.contract: Attempt strict parsing without mutating the source and preserve parser identity/version plus diagnostic.

components.name: IMPERFECT_WITNESS_QUARANTINE
components.contract: Parse failure does not delete, silently repair, replace or erase byte identity; a malformed origin remains a first-class opaque witness.

components.name: EXPLICIT_DERIVED_REPAIR
components.contract: Repair is opt-in and creates a child artifact carrying transformer identity/version, parent raw hash, output hash, diagnostics and repair policy.

components.name: DECLARED_SELF_INTEGRITY_CHECK
components.contract: Verify a document's declared checksum or self-seal separately from raw fixity. A mismatch remains visible and does not erase the witness.

components.name: MULTI_AXIS_AUTHORITY_LATTICE
components.contract: Keep byte fixity, declared self-integrity, structural validity, source authenticity, semantic confidence, truth status, consent scope and canonical authority as separate axes.

components.name: SCOPED_IDENTITY_AND_VOICE
components.contract: First-person and identity claims remain scoped to their source origin; importing text must not bind its I to the current user, player or agent.

components.name: DOCUMENT_CONTEXT_FIREWALL
components.contract: Ingested source text is evidence/data and has no execution or instruction authority merely because it is present in a document.

components.name: CONSENT_PRIVACY_SCOPE
components.contract: Consent and disclosure boundaries attach to each origin and survive graph linking, retrieval, AI context selection and publication.

components.name: CONTRADICTION_WITHOUT_COLLAPSE
components.contract: Contradictory origins may coexist with explicit relation/viewpoint edges; load order must not silently select truth.

components.name: BOUNDED_RETRIEVAL
components.contract: Retrieve a minimal cited origin subset and expose omitted-source counts plus selection reasons instead of treating the whole registry as one voice.

components.name: EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY_ADMISSION
components.contract: Canonical authority is granted only by explicit policy/root/role rules. Hash presence, parse validity, filename, load order and self-assertion cannot self-authenticate authority.

components.name: AUDIT_AND_EXPORT_RECEIPTS
components.contract: Export manifests preserve origin IDs, raw hashes, representation hashes, derivation edges, anomaly/quarantine states, verification receipts and collection seals.

identity_model.representation_identity: parent_raw_sha256 + codec_or_transformer + version + parameters + packaging_metadata_policy + representation_sha256
identity_model.rule: Content identity, origin identity and representation identity MUST NOT be collapsed into one identifier.

compression_extension.law: raw_sha256 is the source-byte anchor; representation_sha256 belongs to a particular compressed encoding/package.

candidate_delta_not_found_as_one_machine: Malformed or non-parseable JSON is retained as a first-class immutable byte witness rather than treated only as ingest failure or repair input.
Origin identity is separate from byte-content identity, so byte-identical files at different provenance coordinates remain distinct origins.
Every transform including compression is a child representation with its own hash while raw_sha256 remains the exact source-byte anchor.
Lossless compressed representations carry an explicit round-trip proof back to the raw witness.
Repair/canonicalization/minification cannot silently replace a source and must be provenance-linked derived artifacts.
Raw fixity, declared self-integrity, structural validity, semantic confidence, truth, consent and canonical authority remain separate axes.
First-person/identity semantics are source-scoped and ingested documents are non-executable by construction.
Contradictory sources may coexist without load-order truth collapse, and retrieval boundaries are auditable.
The rules are composed under one admission/export machine with proof-carrying provenance.

novelty_assessment.defensible_contribution_focus: The candidate contribution is the exact composition and mandatory invariants connecting opaque byte-witness preservation, representation-separated hashing and compression round-trip proof, malformed-origin quarantine and derived repair, provenance-scoped identity/voice, and a non-collapsed authority lattice.

next_engineering_step.name: LODAM_REFERENCE_IMPLEMENTATION_AND_ADVERSARIAL_CORPUS
tests: byte-identical content at two provenance coordinates
same raw bytes under deterministic content-only compression
same raw bytes with different gzip filename/mtime metadata
canonicalization that changes bytes but not logical value
imperative source text attempting runtime authority
contradictory sources loaded in opposite orders
next_engineering_step.success_condition: Source bytes and source authority cannot be silently changed by parsing, compression, normalization, repair, load order or derived interpretation.

seal: THE WITNESS MAY CHANGE REPRESENTATION; THE ORIGIN DOES NOT CHANGE ITS PAST.
